rule: Each entry is a file that still names a site host in code, outside the generated outputs of tools/build-site-hosts.mjs: its count of host literals (comments are not counted) and the stage that converts it. The list only shrinks (scripts/test/site-hosts.test.mjs): a file on no list may not name a host, a listed file may not name more hosts than its count, and a file that names none leaves its list.
how_to_leave: Convert the file to read its hosts from workers/mccluster/src/platform/hosts.generated.js, run node tools/build-site-hosts.mjs --scan, and lower the count to what the scan prints; at zero delete the entry. Never raise a count. Edit only your own lane's list.

files.note: Generated by tools/build-company-site.mjs from data/seo/company-site.json and data/seo/entity-graph.json (the company page, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt). P2 points that generator at this record; then this file joins the generated outputs.

The owner's Seek First console (served as text by src/index.js): its sign-in copy and the address of its own fragment hand-off page (auth/seek-first-handoff.html), which SPEC-PLATFORM 2.6 leaves outside this move and lists for the same review as the bar's hand-off. Converting it means rendering the console's HTML with the table at serve time. Not converted in P0: it is reviewed with the bar's hand-off when P1 turns the fragment hand-off off, and it must be converted before P3, when matthew.mccluster.org/auth/ answers 301 to the platform (/auth/ pages are url_ownership.platform).
